name: Voxel Ray Marching with Traversal Order Optimization
definition: A ray marching algorithm for world-space aligned voxel textures that minimizes floating-point operations by precomputing step deltas and determining traversal order via comparison of t_max values for each axis.
summary: Voxel Ray Marching with Traversal Order Optimization renders 3D volumes by analytically advancing rays between cell boundaries using precomputed deltas, minimizing floating-point operations compared to fixed-step methods.
